propositions: Unguarded gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml hard-fail when repo scripts are absent from the checked-out tree, because Gerrit Verified lane uses the workflow definition from target branch but checks out the change's tree.
Multiple gate steps added on main run against open changes whose base predates the script, causing false Verified -1 failures when the script does not exist in the patchset.
A gate step running a repo script without an if-present guard must skip with a log line when the script is absent, matching the convention established in bug 7e90.
All 11 enumerated unguarded steps (9 in _build-and-test.yml, 2 in gerrit-verify.yaml) require structural guards to prevent definition-vs-tree skew failures.
A structural detector must fail the build if any Verified lane job checks out the change tree and runs a repo script without an if-present guard.
